test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the sentence that correctly changes the tense of the following from present simple to past perfect.

"Advocates claim it offers health benefits beyond mere sodium intake."

options.text: Advocates claimed it had offered health benefits beyond mere sodium intake.
Advocates had claimed it offered health benefits beyond mere sodium intake.
Advocates had claimed it had offered health benefits beyond mere sodium intake.
Advocates claimed it had been offering health benefits beyond mere sodium intake.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To transform a sentence from **Present Simple** to **Past Perfect**, we must change the finite verbs in both the main clause and the subordinate clause to follow the $had + V3$ (past participle) structure.
 
• **Original (Present Simple):** *Advocates **claim** (V1) it **offers** (V1) health benefits...*
